cases.description: A member reads the Voice ID notice and consents.
procedure: Sign in as Member C and open "Giọng nói của tôi" (/mgmt/my-voice).
Read the notice, tick "Tôi đã đọc và đồng ý cho hệ thống lưu đặc trưng giọng nói của tôi cho mục đích trên." and click "Đồng ý và bật".
expected: The notice states Mục đích, Ai thu, Lưu gì, Dùng ở đâu, Quyền của tôi, Bên kiểm soát dữ liệu and that a voice is sensitive personal data; the box is not ticked and the button is disabled until it is.
Toast "Đã bật nhận diện giọng nói cho tài khoản của bạn."; chip "Đang bật"; the consent is on the current notice version.
preconditions: Member C has no Voice ID consent.

cases.description: The Administrator (Thu giọng mẫu hộ) opens Member C's proxy collection, asks first, and records a sample.
procedure: As the Administrator open /mgmt/admin/users, click "Quản lý giọng nói thu hộ của Đặng Quốc Bảo".
Click "Thu"; look at "Bắt đầu ghi" before ticking anything.
Ask Member C, tick "Đã hỏi, Đặng Quốc Bảo đồng ý cho thu giọng mẫu lần này", record Member C reading the passage and click "Lưu giọng mẫu".
expected: The dialog "Giọng nói thu hộ: Đặng Quốc Bảo" shows the sample count and "Thu" (the person has consented).
"Bắt đầu ghi" and "Lưu giọng mẫu" stay disabled until the agreement box is ticked.
The sample is saved ("Đã lưu giọng mẫu thu hộ.") and Member C is notified.
preconditions: TC01 passed; a person reading aloud; the speech worker computes the voice embedding.

cases.description: Transcribing a meeting where Member C spoke suggests and fills Member C's name on their sentences.
procedure: As the Secretary upload audio of Member A and Member C speaking to a meeting both attend and open the transcript.
expected: Member C's sentences carry their name (filled automatically when the match is clear, ADR-0074); the other voice stays unnamed or suggested.
preconditions: TC02 passed; the speech worker is running.

cases.description: Member C withdraws consent; every sample is deleted and the collector can no longer record them.
procedure: As Member C on "Giọng nói của tôi" click "Tắt và xoá giọng mẫu" and confirm "Tắt và xoá".
As the Administrator open Member C's proxy collection again.
expected: The dialog "Tắt nhận diện giọng nói?" warns first; toast "Đã tắt nhận diện giọng nói và xoá toàn bộ giọng mẫu."; the consent box is unticked again.
No sample of Member C is left; the collector's dialog has no "Thu" (consented false).
